exposure: Maternal abdominal subcutaneous fat thickness (SFT) at 18-22 weeks gestation (SFT2)
Maternal abdominal subcutaneous fat thickness (SFT) at 11-14 weeks gestation (SFT1)
outcome: Admission to neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: 1510 pregnant women attending routine obstetric ultrasounds in Sydney, Australia, between 2012 and 2014
finding: Maternal abdominal subcutaneous fat thickness, measured by ultrasound during pregnancy, was a significant independent predictor of adverse pregnancy outcomes, even after adjusting for body mass index (BMI).
